state.what: services/MprisController.qml keeps a workaround for plasma-browser-integration reporting Playing with a frozen Position after a tab's media ends: while a plasma browser player is Playing and playerctl exists, a 3 s Timer forks `playerctl -p <bus> position`; frozen across 3 polls (~9 s) marks the player stale and hides the media card.
state.origin: Came in with the 2026-07-29 import of the shell (commit 7304e6bdf); no record of who observed the freeze or when.
state.reproduction: The founder's TODO: not reproduced in two attempts against the real host; real media ending goes Paused with Position pinned at the length, and tearing the element out drops the bus name.
state.J46_evidence: Stub MPRIS player on a private bus, headless (tests/test_mpris_phantom.sh, commit 084d1c7b9): (1) Paused at length: a paused card shows, identical with or without the workaround (its timer only runs while Playing). (2) Bus name dropped: card gone within 1 s, both ways. (3) Playing with frozen Position (the workaround's case, never seen on the real host): with it, flagged stale at ~9 s; without it the phantom Playing card stays until the browser exits.
state.cost_of_keeping: One playerctl fork every 3 s for as long as a browser plays media (about 1200 forks per hour of video), ~40 lines of code. The project tracks shell idle power.
state.cost_of_removing: If the freeze ever happens, a stale Playing card stays on the bar/panel until the browser closes. Cosmetic, no data loss.
state.reversibility: Removal is one separate commit (d5e031fdc) on dev; revertable.

J46_media_workaround.instructions: Keep or remove the plasma-browser stale-position workaround?

criteria.keep_workaround: Drop d5e031fdc. Strongest case: guards a failure someone wrote code for, at small cost; the evidence only shows it is unproven, not unneeded.
criteria.remove_workaround: Merge d5e031fdc. Strongest case: the failure was never reproduced on the real host, the two real behaviours are clean without it, and it forks a process every 3 s during all browser playback.
criteria.need_more_facts: Neither is supported yet; name the fact.
